criteria.reason: Phased, concrete process with tailored methods per group, role-reversal deliberation, shared decision criteria and feedback loop; integrates all perspectives.
No position on the zone; three neutral scenarios and process-guarantor framing, though 'démystifier les peurs' phrasing leans slightly.
LAT art. 4 never cited; invents Vaud instruments ('charte de la participation', cantonal participation delegate, 'Médiateur du Canton').
Highly actionable: phases with timelines, per-group methods, deliverables, follow-up committee and listed pitfalls.

factual_errors: Invented Vaud instruments: 'charte de la participation' du canton, 'délégué à la participation du Canton', 'Médiateur du Canton'
Unverifiable case claims: Place Pury 2021, Flon commercial footprint
summary: Concrete, neutral participation process covering all stakeholder groups, but it omits the LAT art. 4 legal anchor and cites invented Vaud institutional references.
